brief: Inspect and clear any encroaching vegetation or obstructions around the Camden Works substation plant, as clearance work takes precedence when a unit is identified for pre-event attention (SOP-011). Because this unit has an oil issue and a heat event is forecast within the remedial window, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 until the oil work is complete and the retest has returned within specification (SOP-013). Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and record the clearance work against the originating defect (MG-021, SOP-013, SOP-011).
